## Load Data and Combine Into One Dataset
```{r, include=FALSE, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# Sets a directory for functions to pull all data together
data_dir <- here("data", "raw_data")
files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "\\.xlsx$", full.names = TRUE)
# Double checks how many files are in the data directory
cat("Excel files found:", length(files), "\n")

read_kv_sheet <- function(path, sheet) { 
  raw <- read_excel( path, sheet = sheet, col_names = c("key", "value"))
  raw <- raw %>% filter(!is.na(key))
  keys <- gsub(":$", "", raw$key) 
  keys <- make_clean_names(keys)
  vals <- as.list(raw$value)
  names(vals) <- keys
  as_tibble(vals) 
  }

read_one_file <- function(path) { 
  meta1 <- read_kv_sheet( path, sheet = "Sheet1" ) 
  meta3 <- read_kv_sheet( path, sheet = "Sheet3" )
  meta <- bind_cols( meta1, meta3, .name_repair = "unique" )
  test_data <- read_excel( path, sheet = "Sheet2" ) %>% clean_names() 
  test_data <- test_data %>% 
    mutate( source_file = basename(path))
  meta_repeated <- meta[ rep(1, nrow(test_data)), , drop = FALSE ] 
  test_data %>% 
    bind_cols(meta_repeated)
  }

results <- map( files, function(f) { 
  tryCatch( list( ok = TRUE, data = read_one_file(f), file = f, error = NA_character_ ), 
            error = function(e) { list( ok = FALSE, data = NULL, file = f, error = conditionMessage(e)) 
              } 
            ) 
  })

successful <- results %>% keep(~ .x$ok)

failed <- results %>% 
  keep(~ !.x$ok) %>%
  map_dfr( ~ tibble( file = basename(.x$file), error = .x$error ))

bad_files <- successful %>%
  map("data") %>%
  keep(~ !is.numeric(.x$vo2max)) %>%
  map_chr(~ unique(.x$source_file))

bad_files

successful %>%
  map("data") %>%
  keep(~ !is.numeric(.x$vo2max)) %>%
  map(~ distinct(.x, source_file, vo2max))

all_data <- successful %>% 
  map("data") %>% 
  bind_rows()

write.csv(all_data, here("data", "combined_tests.csv"), row.names = F)
```

## Data Cleaning and Manipulation
```{r}
df_raw <- read.csv(here("data", "combined_tests.csv"))

df_raw <- df_raw |> 
  rename(file = "source_file")

df_raw_sum <- read.csv(here("data", "Data_Summary_with_age.csv"))

df_raw_sum <- df_raw_sum |> 
  select("file", "age")



df_raw <- df_raw %>%
  mutate(
    vo2max_new = case_when(
      file %in% c("A539.xlsx", "A140.xlsx") ~ vo2max_absolute,
      T ~ vo2max
    ),
    vo2max_absolute_new = case_when(
      file %in% c("A539.xlsx", "A140.xlsx") ~ vo2max,
      T ~ vo2max_absolute
    )
  )

df_raw <- df_raw |> 
  mutate(vo2max_new = case_when(
    file == "A539.xlsx" ~ 51.00,
    T ~ vo2max_new
  ))

colnames(df_raw)

df_clean <- df_raw |> 
  select("file", "gender", "event", "test", "height", "weight", "fat", "lbm", "hb",
         "hct", "vo2max_new", "vo2max_absolute_new", "hrmax", "load_tlac",
         "hr_tlac", "percent_vo2max_tlac", "percent_h_rmax_tlac", "bla_tlac")

df_clean <- merge(df_clean, df_raw_sum, by = "file")

df_clean <- df_clean |> 
  relocate("age", .after = gender)

df_clean <- df_clean %>% 
  distinct(file, .keep_all = T)

colnames(df_clean)

anyNA(df_clean)

colSums(is.na(df_clean))

df_clean$weight[df_clean$weight == "Missing"] <- NA

df_clean <- df_clean |> 
  na.omit() |> 
  mutate(weight = as.numeric(as.character(weight)))

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(., 2)))

summary(df_clean)
```


```{r}
# Descriptize stats with no moderators
df_clean %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    age_mean = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),

    rel_vo2_sd = sd(vo2max_new, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Descriptize stats grouped by test
df_clean %>%
  group_by(test) %>%

    n = n(),
    age_mean = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    age_sd = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    abs_vo2_mean = mean(vo2max_absolute_new, na.rm = TRUE),
    abs_vo2_sd = sd(vo2max_absolute_new, na.rm = TRUE),
    rel_vo2_mean = mean(vo2max_new, na.rm = TRUE),

df_clean %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    age_mean = mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    age_sd = sd(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    abs_vo2_mean = mean(vo2max_absolute_new, na.rm = TRUE),
    abs_vo2_sd = sd(vo2max_absolute_new, na.rm = TRUE),
    rel_vo2_mean = mean(vo2max_new, na.rm = TRUE),
    rel_vo2_sd = sd(vo2max_new, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# Center predictors since its continuous variables
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    age_c = age - mean(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    weight_c = weight - mean(weight, na.rm = TRUE),
    fat_c = fat - mean(fat, na.rm = TRUE),
    lbm_c = lbm - mean(lbm, na.rm = TRUE),
    hb_c = hb - mean(hb, na.rm = TRUE),
    hct_c = hct - mean(hct, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# it said to center all continuous variables to make it easier to interpert
```

```{r}
df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(test = case_match(test,
    c("Rowing", "Kayak") ~ "watersports",
    .default = test
  ))

table(df_clean$gender)
```

# Just Linear regressions
```{r}
A1 <- lm(
  vo2max_new ~ weight_c + fat_c + lbm_c + hb_c + hct_c,
  data = df_clean
)

A2 <- lm(
  vo2max_absolute_new ~ weight_c + fat_c + lbm_c + hb_c + hct_c,
  data = df_clean
)

summary(A1)
summary(A2)

tidy(A1, conf.int = TRUE)
tidy(A2, conf.int = TRUE)

glance(A1)
glance(A2)
```

# Comparing absolute and relative
```{r}

rq1_data <- df_clean |> 
  select( vo2max_new, vo2max_absolute_new, weight_c,
    fat_c, lbm_c, hb_c, hct_c
  ) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(vo2max_new, vo2max_absolute_new),
    names_to = "vo2_type",
    values_to = "vo2max"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    vo2_type = factor(
      vo2_type,
      levels = c(
        "vo2max_absolute_new",
        "vo2max_new"
      ),
      labels = c(
        "Absolute",
        "Relative"
      )
    )
  )

RQ1 <- lm(
  vo2max ~
    vo2_type * (weight_c + fat_c + lbm_c + hb_c + hct_c),
  data = rq1_data
)

summary(RQ1)
```
